description_en: Queries all tag keys and the number of Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instances to which each tag key is added
description_zh: 查询所有标签键及标签键关联的DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的数量
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-tag-keys --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTagKeys

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例所属地域ID。取值固定为cn-hangzhou，表示中国内地，即DDoS高防（中国内地）服务
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Set the value to INSTANCE, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Pro instance
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值固定为INSTANCE，表示DDoS高防实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含标签键的数量。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页包含标签键的数量

TagKeys.description_en: The details about the tag keys

TagCount.description_en: The number of Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instances to which the tag key is added
TagCount.description_zh: 标签键关联的DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的标签键的总数量
